functions.name: core_fault_set_callback
functions.brief: Register a fault callback, run in fault context before the SOS blink (and before the L4's USB register dump). Keep it minimal: no heap, no interrupts.

params.name: cb
params.description: Callback receiving the fault type and stacked frame; NULL removes it.

functions.name: hal_fault_set_callback
functions.brief: Register a fault callback (optional). Called on every Core before the SOS blink (and before the L4's USB dump).

params.name: cb
params.description: Callback run in fault context; NULL removes it.

types.name: core_fault_cb_t
types.brief: Fault callback: the fault type (hard, memory management, bus, usage) and the register frame the core stacked on exception entry.
